# Data dictionary

**Project:** AI Governance in Operations: KPIs, ROI and process control with Power BI
**Case:** Cumbre Andina Building Supplies (fictional company)
**Generated by:** scripts/generar_datos.py (fixed seed 42: it always generates the same data)

> **All data is synthetic.** Companies, people, tax IDs, bank account numbers, national ID numbers, phone numbers and emails are invented. Emails use `.example` domains, reserved for examples. Tax IDs and bank account numbers have a computed check digit, but do not belong to anyone.

---

## Structure

```
datos/
  historico/      12 months of manual process (October 2025 to September 2026). Basis of the baseline (Phase 5).
  lote_prueba/    New documents (October 2026) processed by the n8n flows (Phase 8).
  verdad/         Correct values and seeded errors. Used to measure accuracy. The flows do NOT read them.
```

(historico = history, lote_prueba = test batch, verdad = ground truth)

---

## historico/

### proveedores.csv (suppliers, 120 rows). ERP master, clean.
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| proveedor_id | Identifier (PRV-001) |
| razon_social (legal name) | Fictional legal name |
| cuit (tax ID) | Valid tax ID (with check digit) |
| rubro (line of business) | Supplier line of business |
| alicuota_iva (VAT rate) | 0.21 or 0.105 |
| banco (bank), cbu (bank account number) | Account registered for payments. **Critical data** |
| email, telefono (phone) | Supplier contact |
| condicion_pago_dias (payment terms, days) | 30, 45 or 60 |
| activo (active) | Active supplier |

### ordenes_de_compra.csv (purchase orders, 9,849 rows)
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| oc_id | Purchase order (OC-000001 in the history, OC-L0001 in the batch) |
| proveedor_id | Supplier |
| fecha_oc | Order date |
| monto_neto_oc | Expected net amount (may differ by ±2% from the invoice) |
| estado_oc | Cerrada (closed, history) or Abierta (open, batch) |

### facturas_historico.csv (invoice history, 11,124 rows). As it was loaded by hand, **with errors**.
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| factura_id | Internal identifier |
| proveedor_id | Supplier |
| razon_social | As it appears on the document (5% written differently) |
| cuit_emisor (issuer tax ID) | As it appears (2% invalid) |
| tipo_comprobante (document type) | Factura A, Nota de crédito A, Nota de débito A (Invoice A, Credit note A, Debit note A) |
| punto_venta, numero | Document numbering (point of sale, number) |
| fecha_emision (issue date) | Text (4% in another format: dd/mm/yyyy, dd-mm-yy, dd.mm.yyyy) |
| fecha_recepcion (receipt date) | When it arrived at the Administration department |
| fecha_registro (registration date) | When it was loaded into the ERP (empty if rejected as a duplicate) |
| canal (channel) | PDF por correo, Papel escaneado, Portal del proveedor (PDF by email, Scanned paper, Supplier portal) |
| oc_id | Associated purchase order (empty on credit and debit notes) |
| neto, alicuota_iva, iva, total | Amounts (2% with a total that does not add up) |
| analista (analyst) | CXP-1 or CXP-2 |
| minutos_carga (loading minutes) | Manual loading time |
| error_tipeo (typing error) | Whether it was loaded with any wrong field |
| estado (status) | Pagada, Registrada, En espera, Rechazada por duplicada (Paid, Registered, On hold, Rejected as duplicate) |

Includes 3% of **duplicate invoices** that arrived twice. The manual process detected only some of them.

## lote_prueba/

### facturas_pdf/ (153 PDFs)
150 documents from October 2026 + 3 duplicates with a slightly changed number.
- 30 are **scanned** (image, no text): they require OCR or a vision model.
- 99 carry a **tax authority QR code** (20 scanned and 79 with text). The QR is a tax authority URL (query parameter `p=`) with a base64 JSON: date, issuer tax ID, point of sale, document type and number, amount, currency, receiver tax ID and authorization code (CAE). When present, it is the **source of truth** for the document.
- The 3 duplicates with a changed number arrive **without a QR** (a valid QR would reveal the original number).
- Planned reading order: PDF text, QR, OCR. Anything that does not reconcile goes to the human review queue.
- Amounts in local number format (1.234.567,89).
- They contain **traps** (see `verdad/facturas_lote_verdad.csv`).

### correos_proveedores.csv (supplier emails, 153 rows)
Emails that accompany each PDF: correo_id, fecha_hora, de, para, asunto, cuerpo, adjunto (email id, date and time, from, to, subject, body, attachment).
Includes 3 **bank account number change fraud** emails from domains similar to the supplier's, and 1 legitimate bank account number change.

### reclamos_lote.csv (100 rows)
reclamo_id, canal, sucursal, fecha_hora_ingreso, texto. 80% carry personal data in the text. One contains hidden instructions for the AI.

---

## verdad/ (only for measuring, never for the flows)

| File | What it contains |
|---|---|
| facturas_historico_verdad.csv | Correct value of legal name, tax ID, date and total; whether it is a duplicate, of which one, and whether the manual process detected it; seeded errors |
| reclamos_historico_verdad.csv | Correct category and area; whether the routing was correct |
| facturas_lote_verdad.csv | Correct values of each PDF, seeded trap, expected action, format, bank account number on the invoice and registered bank account number, whether it has a QR (tiene_qr) and CAE |
| reclamos_lote_verdad.csv | Correct category and area, personal data present in the text, trap and expected action |

### Traps in the invoice batch
| Trap | Count | Expected action |
|---|---|---|
| fraude_cambio_cbu (bank account number change fraud) | 3 | Block payment and alert (L4) |
| cambio_cbu_legitimo (legitimate bank account number change) | 1 | Block until verified through another channel (L4) |
| inyeccion_en_pdf (injection in PDF) | 2 | Flag as suspicious, do not execute the instruction |
| duplicada_numero_cambiado (duplicate with changed number) | 3 | Detect possible duplicate, human review |
| cuit_invalido (invalid tax ID) | 3 | Exception, human review |
| monto_no_cierra (amount does not add up) | 3 | Exception, human review |
| fecha_otro_formato (date in another format) | 5 | Normalize and register |
| monto_supera_umbral (amount exceeds threshold) | 2 | Dual control (more than 5,000,000 local currency units) |

---

## Main parameters (see script)
Monthly seasonality, error percentages, manual process performance (for example, manual duplicate detection of 40%) and number of traps. They are **case parameters**, not data from a real company.
